title: mcp: agent_prompt reads the kernel metadata service and misses package-shipped agents that /meta/agent/NAME serves (bare-name phase 3, Q5)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o8PE7ZtVjcor51wBZ

Filing gate: ② execution of a maintainer ruling. This is Q5 of the bare-name phase 3 plan (#30806, plan 6719833098), which the maintainer ruled A, as its own card after phase 3 (seat record 6721537981). ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: the `domain:server` seat that owns MCP (`plugin-mcp` and its tools), from `pm:queue` once #30806 closes.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `agent_prompt kernel metadata package agent`, `MCP agent_prompt meta/agent` → #30806 and #30803 only.
reach: every MCP client that asks `agent_prompt` for an agent a package ships.
class: a · type: Bug
Grade: p3, self-graded by the server seat (Ruling-ref: 「定级你可以自己决定」).

## 维护者速读

MCP 的 `agent_prompt` 读的是内核 metadata 服务，看不到包里自带的 agent；而 `GET /meta/agent/NAME` 能读到。两个读“按名取 agent”的入口不一致。按裁决（#30806 Q5 = A），在 bare-name 第三阶段完成后，让 MCP 改走协议的 agent 读取，只留一个读者。

## What is wrong (from the contract review of PR #31375, record 6717571232, and the seat note 6717580545 on #30806)

- `GET /meta/agent/NAME` serves a package-shipped agent. MCP `agent_prompt` reads the kernel `metadata` service, which does not see it. Two readers of "an agent by name" disagree (ADR-0063 §2 direction).

## Expected

- MCP `agent_prompt` resolves an agent through the same protocol read as `GET /meta/agent/NAME`. Phase 3's namespaced names apply.
- Pins: a package-shipped agent is served by `agent_prompt`, measured red on main first. CONTROL: an environment agent is served as today.
- What an MCP client is served changes, which is runtime visibility on the human floor. The dev declares `Clause-②` from the diff, and the seat reviews it before landing.
